card.text: M21 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,202 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6531: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 1201.83264598 pc (16th to 84th percentile 1199 to 1205)

sources.quote: Messier 21 or M21, also designated NGC 6531 or Webb's Cross, is an open cluster of stars located to the north-east of Sagittarius in the night sky, close to the Messier objects M20 to M25.

introduction.text: M21 is drawn as 212 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
